name: ah-ready-pr-review
description: Review a ready (non-draft) pull request using the AgentHub reviewer in packages/coding-agent-dispatch/reviewer. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

steps.prompt: Using gh, confirm pull request {{pull_request}} in {{repository}} is not a draft and record its head SHA. If it is a draft, stop and report SKIPPED: a draft is never reviewed. Read-only. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Run the AgentHub reviewer (packages/coding-agent-dispatch/reviewer/Invoke-PrReview.ps1) against the pull request given {{previous.output}} and report its verdict with the head SHA. Do not post approvals, merge or edit the branch. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

For a Fail verdict in {{previous.output}}, fix or answer each finding on the author branch, then stop. Do not mark the review passed; a new head commit requires a new review. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.
